answer: Each identity must lock a refundable bond and generate a unique hollow-rooted signal from a non-clonable yarrow hardware token at registration. Every epoch a random subset of agents is challenged to re-prove that exact signal within seconds; mismatch or silence slashes the bond and bars the address. An attacker therefore needs a separate physical token and live response capability for every extra identity, turning N fakes into N devices plus continuous operator attention instead of one script.
